name: Ashaya + Dress Down — CDA is lost with all abilities
notes: Memory: project_cda_pt_ability_loss_fix_2026-04-08. A CDA kept applying after REMOVE_ABILITIES because of the CR 613.7a 'already applied' exemption. Dress Down only removes abilities (it sets no base P/T that would mask the bug), so Ashaya must fall to 0/0 even though lands are on the battlefield; Grizzly Bears is unaffected.
